title: A child hidden by a timeline gives up its space in a stack
body: A `stack` lays out every child, including one a timeline hides until later. In section 11 of `figures/sufr-build.acre` a code block sits below bullets that have not appeared yet, with a gap above it. Layout happens once and a timeline changes only drawing, so the proposal needs a decision: either a stack reflows over time, or a node opts out of layout until it shows.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text: Jack accepted on 2026-11-23, provisionally: a node opts out of layout until it shows, rather than a stack that reflows over time.
